name: Marta
source:
Role: Cellar Keeper 
The eldest member of the congregation, but not the Superior. I wonder why that is? [Spoiler]I suppose she could be a latecomer to Linbarrow; her and Charity both seem to have moved around a lot. At first I thought she was kind and wise, but the more I hear from her the more uneasy I am around her. She is wise, but she is cold. Some of her behavior reminds me of my most vindictive thoughts, which embarrasses and humbles me.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
